summary: Calumet, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to the DOE loan guarantee agreement for its subsidiary Montana Renewables. The First Amendment reduces the guaranteed loan maximum from $1.44 billion to $815.8 million and capitalized interest to $232.8 million, repurposing the expansion to smaller scopes and lowering the cash equity reserve threshold from $80 million to $20 million. This is a routine financing modification, not a special situation, so no deal terms apply. What to watch: ongoing project execution and covenant compliance.
